messages:
maria-security: Quick sync - proposing new defaults for SIEM export retention for app logs. Default exported copies -> 90d, archived encrypted snapshot -> 365d, longer access via JIT unwrap only with ticketed justification.
john-sre: 90d default sounds fine; main ask is how investigations requiring older data are handled. We need a clear exception flow.
lee-platsec: Exception flow idea: require SEC ticket with purpose, approver, and timebox. Mint temporary unmask capability tied to token TTL. No permanent key grants.
sam-ops: Technically we should gate KMS decrypts behind an export-proxy that validates token attrs before calling KMS. Short-lived tokens (<=72h) look easiest to support.
maria-security: Agreed. Proposed command: `export-proxy --ticket SEC-xxxx --service payments-api --ttl 72h`. Proxy mints envelope key and records an audit event. Unwrap requires ticket approval UI.
tess-legal: Legal needs purpose captured, approver identity, and custodian for any >90d access. Also EU tenant exports must remain in EU region and follow regional retention limits. Add region field to ticket template.
audit-bot: auto: event recorded: id=exp-7165432100-1, actor=maria-security, target=payments-api, retention_override=180d, ticket=SEC-9001, ts=7165432100
john-sre: Ensure default redaction for PII fields (email, ssn, payment tokens). If raw data is requested, it must be explicit in ticket and require ops+legal signoff.
lee-platsec: RBAC change proposal: new temporary role siem_exporter:temporary-unmask. Scoped to token lifetime, granted only after approval. Workflow: request -> security approver -> proxy mints token with unmask bit -> KMS unwrap allowed.
sam-ops: Note: some KMS providers lack the condition key we discussed. Proxy should enforce token lifetime and policy before calling KMS. We'll prototype.
maria-security: Also want auto-alerting when someone requests >90d unmask. High-severity notification to security channel and a pager trigger on approvals.
lee-platsec: Storage plan: exported artifacts get object tags with ttl and lifecycle rule to auto-delete. Implement immutability window for legal holds; holds are rare, must attach ticket and be logged.
tess-legal: Confirmed. We'll review ticket template language. Exports for EU tenants require storing in EU region and are subject to DSAR considerations.
john-sre: I'll draft the S3 lifecycle rules and immutability-runbook. Also add size limits and strip query params in export payloads.
sam-ops: I'll build a minimal export-proxy prototype with token minting and a stub approval endpoint. Will enforce redaction by default.
audit-bot: auto: proposal logged: policy_id=policy-5224, default_export_retention=90d, archive_retention=365d, exception_flow=SEC-TICKET
maria-security: Next steps: I'll create SEC ticket template and open a PR for export-proxy changes. @john-sre please own lifecycle rules. @sam-ops prototype proxy. @lee-platsec draft RBAC doc and threat model. @tess-legal review template.
lee-platsec: One more ask - make the unmask requests noisy. I want an alert when any unmask token is minted for >90d.
maria-security: Agreed. Pager for approvals >90d. Closing sync, will follow up with PR links. :white_check_mark:
